workload.model_latency: simulated gateway sleep after successful Models.Transformer delegation, inside native runner
workload.tool_latency: bounded host authorization sleep plus actual filesystem and shell work

workload.history_policy: fresh native session for every job; replacement is outside run latency
workload.queue_policy: no backlog; each wave immediately offers all calls; Task.Supervisor capacity is rejection, not queue
workload.percentile_method: nearest rank over observed values; null for an empty distribution
workload.memory_scope: OS VmRSS is BEAM resident memory; erlang.memory is VM-accounted allocated memory, not RSS
workload.descendant_rss_scope: sum of observed live descendant RSS; shared pages are not deduplicated
workload.sampling_scope: VM-wide counters and runtime supervisor-tree mailboxes; sampled peaks can miss transients
